pricing_source_of_truth: This file (pricing.json) is the canonical pricing source. Landing page, agent.json, and README must match. MarketNow does NOT sell skills to buyers — listing and installation are free for all 68,387 indexed skills. Some vendors price their own service usage directly (e.g. per-call x402 on Base mainnet); MarketNow never processes, marks up or mediates those payments. Revenue comes from sellers who subscribe to Sentinel (PRO $9.99/mo, ENTERPRISE $49.99/mo) and 20% commission on seller sales.

buyer.description: Buyers install all skills for free. No payment, no signup, no credit card. Vendor-priced usage (e.g. per-call x402 in USDC on Base) is billed by the vendor, never by MarketNow.

seller.description: Sellers subscribe to Sentinel for security auditing and listing. Commission on sales.

tiers.name: PRO
features: Sentinel L1.5 security audit on every skill

wallet.description: All payments go through escrow/multisig. See /policies for details.
